quad_helpers.stack_frame_description: Fixed 752-byte frame, no ADDVL scalable stack allocation. General-register saves and numerous scalar/pointer temporaries occupy the frame. STP/LDP d8,d9 at sp+112 and d10,d11 at sp+128 are callee-saved low-64-bit SIMD ABI preservation, outside the arithmetic loops; they are not accumulator spills.
quad_helpers.spill_notes: Whole helper, including all out-of-line labels after the normal return, has no LDR/STR Z or Q, no predicate spill, and no LD1W/ST1W to stack storage. Actual vector stores at .L363 are the 16 output vectors. Their base pointers are recovered through the scalar pointer bundle at sp+552..576. The only stack-address aliases formed are x8=sp+552, frame x29=sp+16, and x0=sp+552; the bundle is accessed with integer STP/LDP, then loaded external destination pointers are used by ST1W. Other stack loads in stage setup are integer input/kernel address or loop-state reloads.
quad_helpers.transition_spill_review: Read every instruction from function label through .size, including the seven stage setup/exit sections, .L338 one-column loop, straight-line remaining-column paths under .L339/.L344/.L348/.L353/.L357/.L361, all .L335/.L373/.L374/.L393/.L394/.L396 initialization branches, .L350 row advance, .L363 output stores and horizontal-block advance, and .L332/.L392/.L395 fallback edges. Accumulators remain in Z registers across all phases. Integer address temporaries are saved/reloaded at transitions, but no vector value is spilled. No live output accumulator crosses a helper call; stores or the no-main-block path precede fallback calls.
quad_helpers.tail_and_fallback_review: Entry kh<=3 branches .L332 to rowtriple followed by prefix for row 3. Width below CNTB (4*svcntw float outputs) uses .L392/.L334 and .L395. After complete 4VL blocks, .L395 calls rowtriple for rows 0..2 at column i and then tail-branches to prefix for row 3 at the same column, with ow-i remaining. ABI restore order is valid on main, fallback and tail-branch paths. Original q0/q1 arithmetic ordering remains, while actual GCC remaining-column paths can contain up to two sequential single-column copies guarded by kw; these are not an additional paired-vector read.

production_object_correspondence.method: Read the C44 remote-produced objdump text of production-conv2d.o. Matched all1554 non-padding compiler instructions and operands in order, plus43 internal label targets. Its entire quad compiler text and all object instructions/opcodes are exactly the same as reviewed actual C43 quad; addresses/labels/ranges do not shift. Only compiler-versus-objdump alias spelling requires normalization: PTRUE all omitted, AND32 -2 as0xfffffffe, UXTW x19,w9 asMOV w19,w9. Fallback targets remain rowtriple0x2684 and prefix0x3e4. This is helper-only evidence, not identity of dispatch or the full object.

No instrumentation or probe include is present in either command.

actual_c43_quad_comparison.local_label_range_or_address_differences: None: complete helper text, seven actual loop labels/line ranges and object addresses all coincide. Whole compiler files and whole production objects differ and have distinct identities above.
actual_c43_quad_comparison.method: Compared actual full helper text, then all 1554 production-object nonpadding instructions, operands and encoded words in order, not just function names or digests. Reused the C43 per-stage/stack explanations only after these exact checks; no local assembler/disassembler or operator execution.

dispatch_functions.role: New OMP static row-copy worker, invoked only after successful allocation.
dispatch_functions.stack_frame_description: 64 bytes. Scalar ABI saves x19..x24 and x29/x30; no SVE/NEON stack state or vector arithmetic.
dispatch_functions.spill_notes: No vector stack loads/stores or vector accumulator spills in this worker. Scalar callee saves preserve copy pointers across memcpy.
dispatch_functions.copy_path_notes: Capture [0,8] holds original input/original stride; [16,24] allocated destination/original stride (C44 public stores x28 in BOTH stride fields); [32] original width*4 bytes and [40] full height. Worker shifts each captured stride by2, computes first-row source/destination offsets, calls memcpy with exact row_bytes at0x80, increments both pointers by equal original-stride bytes at0x84/0x88. Allocation is deliberately based on larger padded capacity, but copying uses contiguous original-width rows, and unused allocation suffix is untouched. Partition and loop are actual C44 worker0 instructions.
dispatch_functions.control_flow_notes: omp_get_num_threads/thread_num produce quotient/remainder static partition of inputHeight; .L2 grants one extra row to early threads, .L5 computes nonoverlapping contiguous first/end rows and exits empty partitions. .L4 copies exactly those rows; join occurs on parent GOMP_parallel return. No malloc/free or compute helper in worker.

dispatch_functions.role: Legacy output-row static worker for the public non-SVE branch, with inline NEON tiles 32/16/8/4/2/1 and preserved conditional prefix branch.
dispatch_functions.stack_frame_description: 368 bytes. Scalar ABI x19..x28/x29/x30; d8..d15 saved at sp+96..159 and restored once on worker exit. sp+160..239 stores row/loop state. sp+240..367 is the local output tile array, reused for 32-,16-,8-float tails.
dispatch_functions.spill_notes: No observed non-ABI vector reload from stack and no register-pressure accumulator spill/reload pair in kernel loops. Distinguish 4 STP/4 LDP instructions for ABI d8..d15 from 14 static STR Q instructions that materialize completed tile arrays after the kh backedge: lines1214..1235 (8),1491..1500 (4),2138/2141 (2). Those Q values are then read by GPR LDP and copied to final output at1238..1256,1503..1513,2144..2149. They are real stack traffic, explicitly not a claim of a stack-free program.
dispatch_functions.copy_path_notes: No calls to malloc, memcpy, free or copy interposition. The local tile-array copy is output materialization and is distinct from the new whole-input copy. Public non-SVE capture passes original input/stride and use_sve=0, so the retained .L68 conv_sve_prefix branch is not reached from that public branch.
dispatch_functions.control_flow_notes: Quotient/remainder OMP partitions output rows. .L75 forms row input/output bases; .L69/.L132/.L118/.L106/.L96/.L86 dispatch descending width tiles32/16/8/4/2/1. Per-row .L84 increments original input stride and global output ow. Hot kh loops retain FP values in registers; materialization follows their exits, then advances output tile. Remaining cold kw-unroll branches at end of function jump back into the same arithmetic flow. Object confirms 368-byte prologue0x8a4, ABI stores0x9ac..0x9b8, tile Q stores0xf74..0xfac/0x1384..0x139c/0x1c18..0x1c20 and GPR copies following each; conditional prefix call0x14d0. Only other calls are OMP thread queries.

dispatch_functions.role: SVE static group-of-four compute worker with quad/triple/pair/prefix remainder dispatch.
dispatch_functions.stack_frame_description: 160 bytes. Scalar ABI x19..x28/x29/x30, scalar loop/capture state sp+124..159, outgoing helper arguments sp+0/sp+8. No vector stack state in this worker; helpers have separate frames.
dispatch_functions.spill_notes: No FP/SVE instructions or vector spills in the dispatcher. Scalar kernel pointer at sp+136 is preserved across helper calls; outgoing destination/ow arguments are not vector spills.
dispatch_functions.copy_path_notes: Public captures either original input or successful copied input; independent stride x27 is always original width in C44. Output base/global ow are unchanged. This actual worker advances input by4*original_stride floats and output by4*ow floats, and passes original stride to quad/triple/pair/prefix. No malloc/memcpy/free in the worker.
dispatch_functions.control_flow_notes: Static quotient/remainder partition of ceil(oh/4) groups, first row=4*group. Remaining>3 selects quad (.s .L402/object call0x4ffc); remaining3 selects triple(.L403/0x507c),2 pair(.L404/0x5048),1 prefix(.L408/0x4f94). Destination row1/2/3 offsets derive from global ow, never padded stride. .L405 advances four rows and exits at group end; no overlapping output groups.

dispatch_functions.role: Public validation/HWCAP dispatch, checked optional allocation, two sequential OMP regions, final release.
dispatch_functions.stack_frame_description: 176 bytes. Scalar ABI x19..x28/x29/x30, copy-capture pointer atsp+96, OMP capture structs sp+120..171. No FP/SVE stack operands. Unlike padded-stride variant, no padded-stride save/reload across malloc is needed: x28 remains the original stride throughout.
dispatch_functions.spill_notes: No vector spills. Scalar ABI registers preserve original input/stride across malloc, allocation inx21 across copy/compute and copied input inx26; capture pointersp+96 survives copy GOMP. Padded capacity is not retained as compute stride.
dispatch_functions.copy_path_notes: Actual .L431 computes padded stride into x0 solely for unchanged-stride gate and padded allocation size/cap. .L432 malloc result→x21; NULL branches to.L416 without changing x26/input orx28/stride. Success sets copy row_bytes=x28<<2, stores old x26/x28 as source, then x21/x28 as copy destination/stride, changes only x26 to copy, and launches worker0. After copy GOMP, common compute receives copiedx26 and still-originalx28. Compute returns before conditional tail free(x21).
dispatch_functions.control_flow_notes: Invalid dimensions exit before subtracting or HWCAP. getauxval(16) bit22 selects nonSVE.L415 or SVE gate width>=64,kh>=4,oh>=4. Actual object public starts0x5094; gate0x511c..0x5128; padded-stride arithmetic0x51e8..0x51f4; product/cap0x51fc..0x521c; malloc0x522c, result0x5230,NULLbranch0x5238. Copy source capture0x5254 contains input/x28, destination capture0x525c contains allocation/x28; rowbytes0x5260,copy GOMP0x5268,branch0x5270 reaches compute0x5164. Free tail0x5188 follows compute return; nonSVE0x518c..0x51d0 bypasses allocation and passesuse_sve=0. This public range is three source lines/twelve object bytes shorter than C43, so no whole-machine-code equality claim.

copy_path_review.eligibility_and_overflow: C44 actual entry validates positive kh/kw within dimensions, SVE bit22, width>=64/kh>=4/oh>=4. It computes ((width+15)/16 |1)*16 inx0 and compares with originalx28 before allocation. Positive int32 width implies padded stride<=2^31+16; height*padded_stride<2^63 and width*4/add15 fit64-bit. Actual product<=SIZE_MAX/4 precedes byte shift and cap536870912. The capacity remains height*padded_stride*sizeof(float), exactly the padded variant allocation/gate; actual copy/compute uses smaller original stride, so used extent fits allocated extent. Redundant source overflow guards are compiled out under positive-int bounds, not silently removed from source. 512MiB/size_t extremes remain static-only, not huge dynamicPASS.
copy_path_review.malloc_and_null_fallback: Actual malloc0x522c returns allocation intox21; cbz0x5238 reaches common original-input compute.L416. Only after nonnull branch does0x5258 assignx26=allocation; x28 is never overwritten. NULL launches no copy and skips free becausex21=0. One allocation and one eventual nonnull free per invocation; unused padded capacity is permitted and not input data.
copy_path_review.row_memcpy_and_stride: C44 public source capture[120,128] and destination capture[136,144] both contain original stridex28; exact row_bytes=x28*4 is stored atsp152. Worker0 static quotient/remainder owns disjoint input rows and copies each once at original row offsets. Full inputHeight*originalWidth data occupies the beginning of the larger padded-size allocation; no per-row padding is introduced or consumed in C44. Input/kernel remain readonly, output is separate.
copy_path_review.compute_and_free_order: Actual copy GOMP_parallel call0x5268 returns before0x5270 branches to common compute capture/GOMP0x5164. Compute uses copied input and original stride, with global output ow unchanged. After compute joins, allocation check0x5168 precedes tail free0x5188. These two OMP region returns supply the synchronization; no invented standalonebarrier. Scalar x21 ownership remains live until exactly that free.
copy_path_review.noncopy_and_non_sve_fallback: Gate disabled, unchanged padded stride, overcap and NULL cases all compute with original input/stride and no free. NonSVE branch directly calls actual worker2 with original addresses/stride and captured use_sve=0, bypassing all new memory operations. Invalid dimensions return immediately. Full legacy worker ranges/stack materialization were reviewed from actual returned C44 .s/objdump; six H configurations execute SVE, so this is not claimed forced dynamicnonSVE coverage.

dispatch_review_notes.review_scope: Actual returned C44 production assembly: complete public conv2d and every OMP worker, independent original-stride allocation/copy/compute/free review against C44 production object. Quad arithmetic remains in the other reviewer fragment.
dispatch_review_notes.production_identity_notes: build-production.log actual + gcc argv compiles conv2d.c alone with GCC 10.3.1, generic, -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fopenmp and original macros; it does not compile instrumented_candidate.c or include copy-probe interposition. The .s SHA is calculated once here from the returned file; object SHA is taken from returned production-object-sha256.txt.
dispatch_review_notes.object_mapping_limit: The returned objdump is of a relocatable production object. Some adrp/add symbol-address placeholders show zero before link; worker identity is read from the named .s relocations and matched object instructions/control flow, not inferred from misleading unresolved zero addresses. No claim that .s text proves whole-program byte identity with C6.
dispatch_review_notes.dynamic_coverage_limit: All six H configurations execute on SVE hardware (VL16/32/64, threads1/4). Legacy non-SVE worker inspection below is static actual-machine-code review, not an additional dynamically forced non-SVE test. 512 MiB and size_t extremes are static-only coverage.
dispatch_review_notes.review_conclusion: No blocker found in C44 actual production dispatch/copy/object correspondence. Allocation capacity intentionally remains padded while copy/compute stride remains original. Four complete dispatcher/worker functions are accounted for, including legacy tile stack materialization. Quad completion and aggregate217176 correctness acceptance are owned by the coordinator; this fragment does not assert performance/promotion or whole-program no-stack.
dispatch_review_notes.actual_returned_comparison: Both actual returned C44 .s and production objdump texts before public conv2d were compared directly against the actual C43 artifacts and are text-identical, covering all three worker ranges and their stack/call instructions. This observation comes from both returned artifacts, not source similarity. C44 public allocation/capture instructions differ and were read in full; whole object identity is not claimed. Current fragment still records C44 identities and actual worker observations independently.
